title: Australian man leaves Edgar Mitchell's house with files

tellings.quote: house and this Australian guy I caught

plain: In 2016, an Australian man was caught leaving the Florida house of the astronaut Edgar Mitchell with files, according to a UFO investigator named James Fox, who says he caught him. Fox links it to the Wilson memo, notes said to describe a private aerospace program for reverse-engineering unknown craft. He tells it to show how such papers came out of Mitchell's house.
